content: Always immediately fulfill a customer's explicit request for a demonstration (e.g., test call) to maintain engagement.

When a customer says 'I'll check with family,' offer a specific follow-up time and incentive (e.g., 'I'll call you tomorrow at 10 AM to answer any questions, and if you decide then, I can include a free case').
Use 'trial close' questions like 'If your daughter agrees, would you like to take this unit home today?' to gauge readiness.
In-store, leverage physical comparison with competitor products to highlight advantages (e.g., 'Compare the screen with this iPad under the same light').

name: Immediate Demo Response
condition: Customer asks to test a specific feature (e.g., camera, sound).
example: Customer: 'Can I see how the camera works?' Salesperson: 'Of course, let's take a photo right now. Notice how fast it focuses and the natural colors.'

name: Scenario Linking
condition: Customer mentions multiple use cases (e.g., reading, video calls).
example: Combine all use cases into a single day narrative: 'You can read news in the morning, browse photos at lunch, and video call your daughter in the afternoon – all on one charge.'

name: Weak Close with Follow-up Anchor
condition: Customer says they need to think or check with someone.
example: Offer a specific follow-up: 'I'll call you tomorrow at 10 AM. If you decide then, I can have the tablet ready with a free screen protector.'

objection: I need to check with my daughter first.
rebuttal_template: I completely understand. How about this: I'll reserve this unit for you with a special 24-hour hold. If you call your daughter now from our store, I can answer any questions she has. And if you decide today, I can include a [free accessory] as a thank-you.

objection: Can we do the Skype test?
rebuttal_template: Absolutely, let's do it right now. (Proceed immediately) While we wait for the call to connect, notice how the screen stays clear even under these bright lights.

objection: Is the screen clear for reading?
rebuttal_template: Let me show you. (Hand tablet to customer) Open a news article and zoom in. See how the text remains sharp? That's the 280 PPI PaperMatte display. Now try it under this lamp – no glare, right?
